notes.raw:
\*Data above 298 K estimated. 
Phase changes: 1533 K, $\alpha-\beta$ transition point of Gd; $\Delta H^{\circ}=0.935$ kcal/mol. 
1585 K, melting point of Gd; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 2.403$ kcal/mol. 
Heat capacity (cal/mol·K) and enthalpy (kcal/mol) equations: 
298.15-2000 K: $Cp^{\circ} = 12.003 + 0.902 \times 10^{-3} T - 0.682 \times 10^{5} T^{-2}$ 
$H^{0}-H_{298}^{0}=12.003\times10^{-3}T+0.451\times10^{-6}T^{2}+0.682\times10^{2}T^{-1}-3.848$ 
Reaction equations (kcal/mol): 
298.15-1533 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -127.423 + 5.045 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} - 1.912 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 457.150 \mathrm{T}^{-1}$ 
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -127.423 - 5.045 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} + 1.912 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 228.575 \mathrm{T}^{-1} + 58.387 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
1533-1585 K: $\Delta \mathrm{Hr}^{\circ} = -127.064 + 1.004 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} + 0.291 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 34.050 \mathrm{T}^{-1}$ 
$\Delta \mathrm{Gr}^{\circ} = -127.064 - 1.004 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} - 0.291 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 17.025 \mathrm{T}^{-1} + 31.980 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
1585-2000 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -126.213 - 1.049 \times 10^{-3} T + 0.291 \times 10^{-6} T^{2} + 34.050 T^{-1}$ 
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -126.213 + 1.049 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} - 0.291 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 17.025 \mathrm{T}^{-1} + 16.315 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
Sources: Enthalpy of formation at 298 K from Fries (42). Low-temperature heat capacities and entropy at 298 K from Vasilev (123). Data above 298 K estimated.
